original: Pesaran, M.H. and Timmermann, A. (1992), A Simple Nonparametric Test of Predictive Performance, Journal of Business & Economic Statistics10(4),461–465
binary_mapping_for_reference: Reference sign-based implementation requires mapping binary directions to -1/+1; passing0/1 directly would incorrectly omit Down/Down hits
variance: Var(P_hat)-Var(P_star), exactly as original formula; no alternative test substituted
p_primary: two-sided normal; one-sided positive normal tail supplemental
constant_forecast: PT not defined for constant forecast; never assign p=1 as an observed PT result
planned_Holm: reserve undefined hypotheses as p=1 internally for correction, report their adjusted p as NA; exactly15 and5 planned hypotheses
